question: State the following statement 'true' or 'false': The direction of the official superior shall ordinarily be in writing.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Every Govt. servant who is in-charge of a work place shall take appropriate steps to prevent sexual harassment to any woman at such work place.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Time limit 60 days is prescribed for granting permission in connection with Press or Radio.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': A Government servant may undertake occasional work of a literary without the previous sanction of the Government.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Prior permission is not necessary for accepting remuneration for services rendered to Cooperative Societies.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Government servant can be permitted to enroll himself as an Advocate, but should not engage himself in the legal profession while in service.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Government servants are permitted to submit joint representation.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Permission for construction of a house is required from competent authority.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Property Return shall be submitted during the month of April for the last financial year.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Movable property includes loans and advances taken by the Government servant.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': A Government servant under suspension continues to remain bound to follow the lawful directions of his superiors during the period of suspension.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': No appeal lies against the order of suspension as it is not a punishment.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Earned Leave can be granted to a Government servant under suspension.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': The period of suspension will be treated as duty for all purposes if a Government servant dies while he is placed under suspension.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': The resignation tendered by an official under suspension should not be accepted until all his accounts are adjusted.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Joining time shall be granted to a Government servant on transfer at his own request.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Not more than one day's joining time shall be allowed to join a new post within the same station.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': Extension of joining time can be granted up to 30 days by the Head of Department.
State the following statement 'true' or 'false': A Government servant on joining time shall be entitled to be paid joining time pay equal to the pay to be drawn in the new post.
